title: Defense

tables.heading: List of skills
tables.caption: Active skills
rows: Shield Slam
Swings your shield at an enemy, dealing Physical Damage and Stunning them for 1.5sec.
Inflicts additional +61% damage if used while under the effects of Energy Shield. Inflicts additional +31% damage on Snared targets. Increases duration of Stun +30% on Enervated targets.
Refreshment
Increases max health for 30min. Only works on caster. While active, you gain 10% of received damage as stacks of Mettle.
Effect increases +20% while under Bear's Vigor.
Bull Rush
Shoves an enemy away with your shield, inflicting Physical Damage and Silencing the target for 3.5sec. Interrupts enemy spellcasting. Increases Aggro generation +200% for 5seconds afterwards.
Stunned targets are Tripped for 4sec. Inflicts additional +42% damage on Stunned targets. Inflicts additional +68% damage if used under the effect of Energy Shield.
Boastful Roar

Inflicts Distressed for 7sec, reducing the enemy's Move Speed -45%, Skill Damage -20%, Attack Speed -250, and Healing effectiveness -60%. Inflicts additional damage equal to 60% of your stacked Mettle, consuming all stacks of Mettle when cast. This ability also Provokes the target, forcing affected players to target you and affected monsters to attack you.
Inflicts +60% damage if used while under the effects of Toughen.
Toughen
Increases Continous Health Regen +48.0 lasts 20sec. While active, you gain 50% of received damage as stacks of Mettle.
Healing effectiveness increased +33% while under Bear's Vigor.
Revitalizing Cheer
Restores Health plus an amount equal to 50% of your stacked Mettle. Consumes all stacked Mettle and cures one debuff.
Effect increases +25% if used while under the effects of Toughen.
Redoubt

Raises shield around the caster for 20sec. Increases Block Rate +25% and decreases Move Speed -10%. Instantly grants Mettle in proportion to the skill's level. Prevents being Pushed or Tripped. Can only be used while a shield is equipped.
Ollo's Hammer
Summons Ollo's hammer and hurls it toward a location; inflicts Trip on an enemy for 2.5sec if it hits. Also deals Physical Damage to all enemies within 3m of the target location.
Inflicts additional +44% damage on Slowed targets. Hammer travels much faster when used on Electric Shock targets.
Mocking Howl

Inflicts Shaken on all enemies within a 7m radius, decreasing Move Speed -27%, Skill Damage -8%, and Attack Speed -75. This ability also Taunts enemies, forcing affected monsters to attack you. Builds additional Aggro equal to 100% of your stacked Mettle, consuming all stacks of Mettle when cast.
Increases threat generation +200% if used while under the effects of Toughen. Provoked Taunted targets. Inflicts Distressed on targets if used while under the effects of Toughen.
Imprison
Imprisons all enemies within a boundary for 12 seconds. Enemies can break out if they use enough force.
Invincibility
Grants immunity to all damage for 9sec. Effect is canceled if you move.
Fortress
Showes away up to 5 enemies within 10m and pulls 5 raid members closer. Decreases pulled raid member's received damage -50% and increases your Mettle +1,500. Effective regardless of target's status.

tables.heading: List of skills
tables.caption: Passive skills
rows: Supplemental Block
Increases Block Rate +15% for 5 seconds after a successful Block.
Shield Edge
Has a small chance to stun the attacker when blocking a melee attack. This ability has a 12sec cooldown once triggered.
Shield of Steel
Increases Physical Defense +900.
Guardian
Permanently increases Aggro generation +50%.
Spry Fortress
Decreases Stun and Tripped duration -10%.
Bear's Vigor
Increases max health +900. Increases the effectiveness of Refreshment +20% and Toughen +33%.
Ursine Roar
Decreases the cooldown of Defense skills -20%. Increases Continuous Health Regen based on Stamina whenever damage is received while below 30% health.
